conclusion.justification: The report explicitly concludes that regular intake of vitamin C does not prevent the common cold for the general population, while noting specific exceptions for people under extreme physical stress. Because it directly states that vitamin C does not prevent colds in general, it rejects the claim.
conclusion.label: rejects

report:
### Conclusion
Your initial impression is correct for the average person: **regular intake of vitamin C does not prevent the common cold** in the general population. However, clinical research highlights important exceptions regarding specific high-stress groups and cold duration.

### Summary of Evidence

* **General Population (No Prevention):** Systematic reviews and trial meta-analyses demonstrate that routine daily supplementation of vitamin C (≥200 mg/day) does not reduce the overall incidence or frequency of common colds in the general public (https://ods.od.nih.gov/factsheets/VitaminC-HealthProfessional/, https://www.cochrane.org/evidence/CD000980_vitamin-c-preventing-and-treating-common-cold).
* **Exception for Extreme Physical Stress:** For individuals undergoing short periods of heavy physical stress or extreme environments (e.g., marathon runners, skiers, and soldiers training in subarctic conditions), regular vitamin C intake cuts cold risk roughly in half (https://lpi.oregonstate.edu/mic/health-disease/common-cold, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8078152/).
* **Reduction in Illness Duration:** While regular supplementation fails to prevent colds in most people, taking it continuously as prophylaxis does have a modest, consistent benefit: it shortens cold duration by about 8% to 9% and reduces symptom severity when an infection occurs (https://www.cochrane.org/evidence/CD000980_vitamin-c-preventing-and-treating-common-cold, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8078152/).

### Sources
* National Institutes of Health, Office of Dietary Supplements: https://ods.od.nih.gov/factsheets/VitaminC-HealthProfessional/
* Cochrane Review: https://www.cochrane.org/evidence/CD000980_vitamin-c-preventing-and-treating-common-cold
* PubMed Central (Cochrane Meta-Analysis): https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8078152/
* Linus Pauling Institute (Oregon State University): https://lpi.oregonstate.edu/mic/health-disease/common-cold
